findings.title: Restore no-stack coverage in the stack-creation test
findings.trigger: A caller constructs a `GraphQLError` from an `originalError` that is truthy but has no `.stack` — the exact case this test names and previously covered with a plain `{ message: 'original' }` fixture.
findings.impact: This diff replaced that fixture with `new Error('original')`, which always has a `.stack`, so the code now takes the stack-reuse branch instead (confirmed: `e.stack === original.stack`). The test's only assertion, `e.stack` is a string, holds either way, so it can no longer catch a regression that weakens the `originalError.stack` presence check and would have failed here before this change.
findings.change: Give `original` no `.stack` (e.g. `delete original.stack` after construction, or an equivalent fixture Flow still accepts as `?Error`) and assert `e.stack !== original.stack` so the fallback path is exercised again.
findings.source: commit-7e39a12/"Enable Flow typings on errors tests"
